name: The Rabbit
source:
"You heard me, be my girlfriend."

The words hit me like a sledgehammer, and my heart felt like it was going to burst out of my chest.

"But why?"

Her thumb stopped moving and she tilted her head to the side, considering me.

"Why not? You're cute when you blush."

"But Cinnamon, you're not serious, are you?"

Her hand remained on my leg, her thumb resuming its gentle stroking.

"Why wouldn't I be? You're pretty, you're friendly, and you're obviously into me."

The Rabbit is a short, kinetic visual novel that focuses on Alice and her past before the events of [url=/v49707]REVERSE[/url].

[From [url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/the-rabbit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你听到了，做我女朋友吧。”

这句话像大锤一样砸在我身上，我的心仿佛要从胸口冲出来。

“但为什么？”

她的拇指停止了移动，把头偏向一边，打量着我。

“为什么不呢？你脸红的时候很可爱。”

“但是肉桂，你不是认真的，对吧？”

她的手仍然放在我的腿上，拇指继续轻轻抚摸。

“我为什么不呢？你很漂亮，你很友善，而且你显然很喜欢我。”

《兔子》是一部简短的动态视觉小说，主要讲述爱丽丝和她在 [url=/v49707]REVERSE[/url] 事件之前的过去。
